thread.text:
Today: Incline Bench opened to plan — 65kg × 8, 8 — then jumped to 70kg × 8 before dropping to 50kg × 12 for the last set. That's three sets at or above the prescribed 65kg × 8, but not the uniform 4×65kg the progression rule needs, so the +2.5kg hasn't technically been earned even though you've already handled more than that for a full set. Pull-ups held slot 2 as prescribed: bodyweight × 10, then +5kg × 8, 8 — first session logged with the added weight. Chest Fly at 65kg went 12, 12, 8 — two sets beat the top of range, third fell short. Slot 4 was Reverse Fly (42.5kg × 8, 8, 10) rather than the prescribed Face Pull, so no read on that progression today. Lateral Raise moved to 8kg × 16, 16, 16.

Trend: Lateral Raise breaks a four-session stall at 15, 15, 15 (09-11 through 09-26) — still short of the 20-hold target for 9kg, but moving. Chest Fly's third set (8) is the one thing holding back the 65kg-for-all-three progression that's been close since 09-21. One Handed Triceps Pull crept up mid-session (7.5kg × 10, 10 → 10kg × 10) without the required two full sessions at range on 7.5kg first — worth confirming that was deliberate.

Right lat: 1/10, green. No rows today since this is Upper A, but it's a good signal heading into Thursday, where the right needs its second green at 55kg after 09-24's 3/10.

Next session: Upper B, Thu 1 Oct. Pull-ups lead, stop two short of failure. Left row 60kg, right holds 55kg — rate pain during the set itself, not just session-level, since that number decides whether the right earns +2.5kg. Lat Pulldown: chase 12 on all three at 67kg.

Question: the incline jump to 70kg then drop to 50kg for the last set — was that a deliberate ramp/test, or a plate mix-up? It changes whether 67.5kg should already be loaded next Monday.
my last set for incline is always more reps based at a lighter weight

That makes sense as a standard back-off set, not a form breakdown — nothing to worry about there.

That means the 65kg×8, 8 plus the 70kg×8 stand as the real working sets. You beat the anchor prescription outright on that third set. Given that, loading 67.5kg for all four working sets next Upper A is reasonable rather than waiting for a cleaner "all four at 8" pattern at 65kg — you've already shown more than that in a single set. I'd flag this to your coach as a case for calling the progression met now rather than strictly by the letter of the rule.
